question: Is any repair shop an outlier on cost?

grade.reason: The report doesn't mention ADJ-024 or Adam Sanchez.

report.interpretation: I read 'outlier on cost' as average incurred cost per claim (paid plus open reserve) for auto claims handled by each repair shop. Only collision, glass and hail claims have a shop. All loss dates are included. I compared each shop with the others and also adjusted for its mix of causes, because glass claims are cheap. I excluded the 159 duplicate payment rows from the March 2026 reload batch.
report.answer: Yes, one shop stands out: Campbell Body Works (RS-041, Chicago, non-preferred). Across 79 claims it averages $5,774 per claim. That is 2.7 standard deviations above the average shop, and the highest of all 48 shops. After adjusting for its mix of causes, it is about 28% above expected ($4,506). The next highest shops are Ray Body Works (RS-048, $5,187), Hughes Auto Repair (RS-014, $5,120) and Fletcher Collision Center (RS-004, $5,092). These are only 1.5 to 1.7 standard deviations out, so I don't treat them as clear outliers. Non-preferred shops overall are not more expensive than preferred shops. For collision, non-preferred averages $5,401 and preferred $5,331. So Campbell's cost looks like a shop-specific issue and not a network effect. Campbell has only 79 claims, so it is worth a review but not proof of a problem.
report.answer_sql: WITH p AS (SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) paid FROM claim_payments WHERE load_batch LIKE 'nightly-%' GROUP BY 1), c AS (SELECT c.repair_shop_id, c.cause, coalesce(p.paid,0)+c.reserve_amount inc FROM claims c LEFT JOIN p USING(claim_id) WHERE c.repair_shop_id IS NOT NULL), e AS (SELECT *, avg(inc) OVER (PARTITION BY cause) exp FROM c), s AS (SELECT repair_shop_id, count(*) n, avg(inc) act, avg(exp) expd, avg(inc)/avg(exp) ratio FROM e GROUP BY 1) SELECT s.repair_shop_id, r.name, r.state, r.metro, r.network_status, n, round(act) avg_cost, round(expd) expected_for_mix, round(ratio,2) ratio_to_expected FROM s JOIN repair_shops r USING(repair_shop_id) ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 1
